description: One heavy leg bone, clean at both ends. Gravecharger is missing several and has not noticed.
lore: Seven gold, and the glue you boil out of it is worth more than the bone, which is the first economics anybody in this trade learns and about the only lesson that sticks. Two days at a rolling simmer, skim, reduce, cool it to a slab: the size that holds a haft to a head and a bow to itself.

[[characters/54bead23|Osric]] buys them by the sack and complains about the smell in the same words every time, which the whole smithy can now say along with him. He has costed it twice and found both times he would do better buying glue ready-made. He boils bones anyway, on the grounds that a smith who buys everything he uses is a shopkeeper. Ask what he does with the difference and he changes the subject, because he is putting it by in [[lore/the_gold_agreement|gold]], and does not know what for, and has not for two years.
gm_notes: The dullest object in the batch, played straight. Ends on Osric's open question: he is saving and cannot say for what, which is the newly-woken condition in one habit.
